Actually, the phrase "並在我的本地銀行帳戶（帳號為987654）進行10美元存款" indicates deposit 10 USD. So we need to deposit 10 USD into account 987654. But the conversion is separate: convert 10 USD to EUR. So we need to call both functions. The question: do we need to deposit the converted amount? No, deposit 10 USD. So we can call currency_conversion first, then deposit. But the deposit uses USD amount. So we can call currency_conversion with amount=10, from_currency="USD", to_currency="EUR". Then deposit with account_id="987654", amount=10.
